# mimecast_roles (Data Source)

Read all account roles with cursor pagination. This requires Directories | Roles | Read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_roles" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable role inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:
